hero_subhead: Expert landscape gardening across Newcastle. From turf laying to complete garden design—we create spaces you'll love spending time in.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From turf installation and planting to garden design and maintenance, we handle every aspect of creating and caring for outdoor spaces.

services.title: Turf Laying & Installation
services.desc: Professional turf installation creates an instant, healthy lawn. We prepare the ground properly, lay quality turf, and ensure it establishes quickly.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Custom garden designs tailored to your space and lifestyle. We plan layouts, material choices, and planting schemes to maximise beauty and usability.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert plant selection and installation for year-round colour and interest. We design borders that thrive in Newcastle's climate and suit your maintenance preferences.

services.title: Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Patios, pathways, decking, and garden structures built to last. We use quality materials and proper construction methods to create functional outdoor areas.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular maintenance keeps gardens looking their best. We offer pruning, weeding, hedge cutting, and seasonal care on a schedule that works for you.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Transformation
services.desc: Overgrown garden? We clear, remove waste responsibly, and prepare the space for a complete redesign or fresh start.

about_pullquote: Every garden deserves to be a place where you want to spend your time.
about_para_1: Cardinal Turf was founded to bring professional landscape gardening within reach of Newcastle families and businesses. Over 8 years, we've transformed 500+ gardens across Tyne & Wear—from small residential plots to larger commercial projects. We combine hands-on expertise with a genuine care for the outdoor spaces we create.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability, honest pricing, and results that last. We listen to what you want from your garden, offer practical advice without pressure, and deliver work that makes you proud. Many of our customers come back year after year for maintenance—the best compliment we can ask for.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Cardinal Turf

reviews.text: Brilliant job with our front garden. The team came on time, worked efficiently, and cleared up properly at the end. The turf has settled beautifully and our street looks so much better. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: James H.

reviews.text: Our back garden was completely overgrown and we didn't know where to start. Cardinal Turf drew up a plan, explained everything clearly, and the whole project was finished in two weeks. Best investment we've made in the house. Highly professional.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Have used Cardinal Turf three times now for maintenance and seasonal work. Always turn up when they say they will, always leave the garden tidy, and genuinely care about the plants. Fair pricing too. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael R.
